notes: attempt-1 was exploratory: it printed the structure, factor levels, and summaries of the four survey data frames, with no RESULT lines. Final script: OLS via lm(). Study 1 (US wave 1, Israel wave 1) regresses each 0-10 outcome on protester-identity and tactic factors (base: white protesters marching in the streets), weighted by the supplied weight variable. Israeli identity coding was assumed to be 0=white Jews, 1=Ethiopian, 2=Arab. Study 2 (US and Israel wave 2) regresses on black (or the Israeli identity factor), group_goal, and commitment, unweighted because those data frames have no weight variable. The police-action model for Study 2 US drops 5 respondents with a missing outcome, giving 3008 observations. Coefficients, SEs, intercepts, and R2 all match the paper's Tables 1 and 2 as printed in paper.txt, on the first scored run, so no claim-driven changes were made.
